desc: Derive the compressed-state rule: for k>=4 the state is winning iff pass-token parity differs from parity of the number of odd A_i; initial pass-token count is 0, so N>=4 Fennec iff odd_count is odd; N=3 Fennec iff odd_count>0; N=2 Snuke; N=1 Fennec.
Implement the O(N) solution in Python with stdin/stdout and the above case rules.
Test samples and edge cases (N=1, N=2, N=3 all even/odd, N>=4 odd/even odd count, large A_i), and optionally brute-force small N/A to confirm.
